counterfactual_text: Each floor contact sends the same ball to a higher rebound peak, so successive bounces grow instead of decay.
positive_text: Each floor contact sends the same ball upward, and every successive rebound reaches a visibly lower peak before the ball rests.
semantic_text: A rubber ball drops onto a hard floor and bounces several times to progressively lower heights before resting. Required visible entities: one rubber ball; one hard level floor; visible vertical drop and rebound corridor. At the beginning: rubber ball: intact, elevated, and spatially separated from the floor; floor: clear around one intended impact point. Required state changes: ball height: elevated to floor and repeated peaks; rebound peak: progressively lower; ball motion state: bouncing to resting. These event variables are allowed to change: ball vertical position and speed; brief deformation at floor contact; successive rebound peak heights; terminal resting state. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; hard-floor geometry; rubber-ball identity and material; one rubber ball; one hard floor; the same impact point and ball identity.
